name: Data Catalog Setup
description: Produces a data catalog structure with table documentation templates, column-level lineage format, and governance tagging taxonomy. Outputs a complete catalog specification for organizing and discovering data assets across an organization. Use when the user asks to set up a data catalog, document their data assets, create a data dictionary, or establish data governance metadata standards. Do NOT use for data schema design (use data-schema-design), data quality rule definitions (use data-quality-rules), or ETL pipeline documentation (use etl-pipeline-design).
